snippet.title: Climb It Up - Co-op Dungeon Parkour - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Climb It Up is a co-op dungeon parkour game where you and your friends climb a massive tower, jump across dangerous gaps, swing with ropes, use grapple hooks, fight skeletons, discover hidden treasures, and try to reach the top together.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/49...

Run through collapsing platforms, magic mushrooms, wooden beams, traps, strange NPCs, secret rewards, dangerous creatures, and chaotic co-op moments where one mistake can send you all the way back down.

If you like co-op platformers, multiplayer parkour games, climbing games, dungeon adventures, physics-based movement, indie games, funny teamwork moments, and intense tower climbing challenges, Climb It Up is being built for you.

The Steam page is coming soon.

Join our Discord to follow development, get updates, and be ready for future playtests:
  / discord  

Follow Team Bravo Games:
X / Twitter: https://x.com/TeamBravoGames
Instagram:   / teambravogames  

Would you save your friend… or keep climbing?

#ClimbItUp #IndieGame #CoopGame
